scope: Single grid-connected converter, 2/4/8/12-state averaged models, Case Studies I–III, Eqs. (23) and (26a,b), appendix equilibrium checks and vector figure comparisons.
scope_zh: 单变流器复杂下垂算例 I–III，2/4/8/12 阶模型、电压跌落、四阶边界、极限环和公式核对。
critical_gaps: The angle printed in the case studies omits the frequency factor if l_g is entered in s/rad. The matched impedance angle was used and checked against the published curves.
Fig. 5 does not disclose the numerical c1 and epsilon settings. The reported comparison uses the open upper envelope of Eq. (26a,b).
Original model files and laboratory traces are unavailable in the reviewed sources. Case IV, full-order sufficient bounds (26c,d), and laboratory experiments remain outside the reproduced scope.

anomaly_evidence.source: Author manuscript Table III, Eq. (16), Cases I and III
anomaly_evidence.finding: Impedance-angle and literal readings give eta/omega0 crossings 0.09977586 and 0.16304868. The former agrees with Fig. 5(a).
The positive-voltage case with polynomial (s-1)^3 has one distinct equilibrium with discriminant zero.
The physical-time constant coefficient needs eta squared. The correction preserves the sign test.
